label: Distributive cause of the received totality: a distinct actual cause of some received bearer
term: distributive cause of the received totality
definition: DistributiveTotalityCause p e holds when some received actual bearer m (ReceivedActual p m) has e as a distinct actual cause of its esse (ActualEsseCause p e m). Every member-cause of a totality of received bearers is a cause of it in this sense; nothing collective is required.
note: Analyst sense for #1724 (C1), attribution deferred; it is the reading under which the Hume-Edwards view grants that a totality of received being is caused (by its members' causes). Dependencies: e7aa4529-fe7a-4baf-929c-466cf15cb0c6, 8163859b-95b3-4dd2-8a69-541bd332f32f. Under this reading premise A holds, classically, whenever anything is received, and premise B (one such cause causes every received member) carries the whole claim; in the Hume-Edwards regress control A holds and B fails. Contrast a95ed85b-627e-4dbe-9810-63b0b6ee1e02, the primitive collective reading. See docs/notes/unique-feedback-explanation-311.md, C1 section.
